name: Vovsoft AI Automator
description:
Vovsoft AI Automator is a lightweight Windows desktop utility that lets you schedule, manage, and run AI language model workflows locally or via cloud APIs, right from your PC with full control and privacy.

Local Hardware & Cloud Flexibility
The software is designed to work with local AI runtimes such as Ollama and LM Studio, which can take advantage of your existing hardware. It can utilize your CPU and GPU for local inference, including NVIDIA RTX, AMD, and Intel. The application can also connect to cloud AI services like OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Gemini, allowing you to choose between local model execution and fast cloud-based processing depending on your needs.

AI Task Scheduler
Setting up scheduled tasks is completely effortless. You can assign prompts to your preferred model to run at specific time intervals, allowing you to choose the exact number of minutes between executions, automating periodic tasks. By configuring the execution timer — combined with the option to auto-run at Windows startup and minimize to the system tray — the software operates silently in the background, continuously interacting with your chosen large language models and saving the results directly to your local drive. This transforms repetitive API interactions into a smooth, completely unattended process.

Batch Prompt Scheduler
The built-in queue system allows you to load batches of text prompts and image/audio inputs to be processed sequentially. You can also manually edit workflows using `tasks.json` and `models.json` files, giving full control over execution behavior without relying only on the GUI. This makes it easy to structure and manage workflows at scale. Instead of manually waiting for one response to finish before sending the next, you can line up hundreds of tasks and step away. The program will systematically route each input to your chosen LLM, and save the generated outputs into your specified destination files.

Flexible Prompt Input
The software can read prompt from external sources, giving you full flexibility in how you define your AI queries. Supported input methods include:
- File: Load your prompt directly from a local file on your system, making it easy to reuse, version, and edit prompts outside the application.
- URL: Fetch prompt content from a specified web address, enabling dynamic or remotely managed prompt workflows.
- Browser: Fetch prompt content directly from a website using an integrated browser, allowing you to capture queries from secured or logged-in sessions.

Simplified AI Automation
The true advantage of this utility lies in its absolute simplicity. While complex automation platforms like n8n or AI agents like OpenClaw offer broad capabilities, they often introduce unnecessary overhead. They typically require configuring and maintaining dedicated servers or cloud instances, which completely contradicts a private, local-first workflow. Furthermore, because of their complex agentic background processes, they can consume massive amounts of tokens, quickly making API usage unexpectedly pricey. In contrast, Vovsoft AI Automator operates entirely as a desktop application on your existing Windows machine. It executes exactly what you schedule with complete transparency, ensuring predictable token usage without any hidden server costs or complicated infrastructure to manage.

name: Vovsoft IP Scanner
description:
Vovsoft IP Scanner is an easy-to-use administration tool built to reveal network devices and ports. Whether you are auditing your local area network (LAN) or scanning external IP ranges across the internet (WAN), it provides fast, accurate, and comprehensive device discovery.

At its core is a high-performance, multi-threaded scanning engine. Instead of processing IP addresses sequentially, the software distributes tasks across multiple concurrent threads, enabling it to ping and probe hundreds of addresses simultaneously. This dramatically reduces scan times, allowing even large subnets to be analyzed in seconds without overloading system resources.

To maximize detection accuracy under different network conditions, the scanner combines three complementary discovery methods:
* Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP): Quickly checks whether a device is reachable by sending echo requests (ping) and measuring response time.
* Address Resolution Protocol (ARP): Reliably identifies devices on the local network by resolving IP addresses to MAC addresses, even if firewalls block other methods.
* Transmission Control Protocol (TCP): Verifies host availability by attempting connection handshakes, useful when ICMP is restricted.

Vovsoft IP Scanner also includes an advanced port scanner module built around Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) for precise service detection. The program allows you to define custom TCP port ranges, giving you full control over which ports are scanned—whether you want a quick check of common services or a full-range audit. By performing TCP handshake attempts, it accurately determines whether ports are open or closed. When a connection is accepted—such as on ports like 80 (HTTP) or 443 (HTTPS)—the software confirms that a service is actively running on the target system. Leveraging its multi-threaded architecture, this port scanner analyzes hundreds of ports in parallel.

Once your scan is complete, you can use the export to CSV feature to easily save and share your data for ongoing security audits, troubleshooting, and network mapping.

Designed as a lightweight Windows application available in both installer and portable editions, Vovsoft IP Scanner handles everything from identifying active network devices to analyzing open ports on remote systems anywhere in the world.

Additionally, the software can summarize the transcriptions, making it even easier to digest podcast content. Experience the future of podcast consumption with this advanced transcription and summarization features today.

name: Vovsoft Prevent Computer Sleep
description:
Vovsoft Prevent Computer Sleep is a simple yet powerful tool designed to keep your PC awake by simulating keypresses at regular intervals. Whether you're running important tasks, watching videos, or giving a presentation, this software ensures that your computer doesn't go into sleep mode or lock the screen due to inactivity.

By default, the program simulates an F15 keypress every 59 seconds, tricking your system into thinking you're still actively working. However, you have full control over these settings. You can easily customize both the key and the time interval to match your preferences. Adjust the time between keypresses (e.g., more frequent or less frequent than 59 seconds) and choose any function key to be simulated.

Key Features:
* Prevents sleep mode and screen lock: Keeps your computer awake by simulating keypresses.
* Customizable intervals: Adjust the time between keypresses (default is 59 seconds).
* Flexible key selection: Simulate any F-key press, default F15 key.
* User-friendly interface: One-click start and stop functionality for hassle-free operation.

Perfect for scenarios where you need your computer to stay active — such as presentations, long-running processes, or periods of low interaction — this utility ensures that your PC remains awake without the need for constant manual input.

name: Vovsoft Prevent Disk Sleep
description:
Modern hard disks are set to automatically enter sleep mode (also known as idle time) whenever file operations are no longer happening. This is a method that is supposed to help with cooling the physical disk and prolonging its lifespan. However, if you wish to prevent this from happening, for example if you want the disk to quickly respond to file operations even after remaining idle for long periods of time, then you can tinker with the built-in settings of your machine to turn off HDD sleep mode. If you find this method to be tedious, though, then you can turn to software utilities capable of keeping the HDD or SSD awake by creating small-sized files just to be able to mimic user interaction. Such a program is Vovsoft Prevent Disk Sleep.

Designed with the casual user in mind, this program is incredibly simple to use. It can be scheduled to create a plain text document (TXT) in any disk of your choice, whether it's local or external USB drive. After a speedy installation that requires minimal intervention, the tool opens a plain window which shows all options available. Once you identify the disks you wish to prevent from sleeping, it's necessary to pick the matching drive letters from a menu, set the disk write interval (in seconds, minimum is 10 seconds), edit the name of the TXT file that will be created, as well as click the 'Start' button.

Vovsoft Prevent Disk Sleep creates the text document with the given name. It's placed inside the specified folder in the selected disk, so it shouldn't be difficult to track down. The application doesn't create multiple files each time it writes to the disk. Instead, it updates the one document by adding date and time stamps. This is also helpful for logging its activity and finding out the exact time of each disk write. Whenever you want to disable the software, simply stop the operation after returning to the main app window. Using this utility ensures that your HDD gets no sleep, keeping it active and responsive at all times.

name: Vovsoft Prime Number Counter
description:
A prime number (or a prime) is a natural number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.

Vovsoft Prime Number Counter is a small utility to calculate the prime numbers. You can make the software count up to a certain number or to infinity. Prime Number Counter displays last found prime number, total number of prime numbers and the elapsed time. You can click "Stop" button whenever you want the software to stop counting. You can also save the generated prime number list as a text file.

name: Vovsoft Print Multiple Web Pages
description:
Vovsoft Print Multiple Web Pages is a batch print utility for HTML files and websites. This web page printing software will help you save time when printing a large number of HTML documents or online web pages in bulk.

You can add many HTML documents or webpage links to the list and preview them in the dedicated area. After you click the "Print All" button, the application will send them all into the printing queue of your default printer.

The application internally uses Internet Explorer engine for preview and printing. You can use the "Browser" menu for displaying web pages using different versions of the browser. You can also use the "Delay after page load" option for better results in case a web page runs time-consuming scripts.

Another useful feature of the program is that it can extract and list all URLs in the entered text. Click "Add URL List" button then make sure you checked "Auto-detect URLs in text" box. The software will list all the addresses in the text one by one for you.

name: Vovsoft Proxy Checker
description:
Vovsoft Proxy Checker is a powerful tool designed to validate and manage your proxy server lists with ease. Supporting a wide range of proxy types, including SOCKS5, SOCKS4, and HTTP proxy servers, this software caters to all your proxy testing needs. Its intuitive interface allows you to effortlessly load and save your proxy lists, ensuring convenient management and quick access to your proxies.
- Comprehensive Proxy Support: Validate and manage proxies with support for SOCKS5, SOCKS4, and HTTP proxy servers, covering a wide range of use cases.
- Effortless Loading and Saving: Easily load your proxy lists from files and save them after testing, ensuring that your lists are always up to date and ready for use.
- User-Friendly Interface: The intuitive and easy-to-navigate interface makes proxy management simple, even for users with limited technical expertise.
- Batch Testing: Test multiple proxies simultaneously to save time and increase efficiency, ensuring that your proxy list is always functional.
- Multi-Threading: Enhance your proxy testing process with this multithreaded proxy checker, allowing multiple proxies to be checked concurrently, significantly reducing testing time and boosting performance.

Whether you're a professional requiring reliable proxies for your tasks, a developer testing your applications, or an individual looking to enhance your online privacy and security, this proxy tester tool provides the essentials needed to maintain a healthy and functional proxy list. Ensure your online activities remain seamless and secure with Proxy Checker for Windows.

name: Vovsoft Proxy Server
description:
Vovsoft Proxy Server is an easily manageable proxy server for Windows. This straightforward tool supports both HTTP and SOCKS protocols, allowing you to enhance privacy, access geo-blocked content, and test applications effortlessly. With its user-friendly interface, creating your proxy server has never been simpler.

Key Features:
* HTTP and SOCKS Support: Supports both HTTP and SOCKS (SOCKS4 and SOCKS5) proxy protocols, allowing flexibility for various applications and use cases. Also supports SSL/TLS, enabling secure connections for HTTPS URLs.
* Easy Control: Simple interface with start and stop buttons for effortless control over the proxy server operations.
* Port Configuration: Users can easily configure and change port numbers to suit their specific networking needs.
* Windows Compatibility: Designed to operate seamlessly on Windows platforms, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of systems.

Use Cases:
- Application Testing: Test applications that require proxy server support without hassle.
- Content Access: Access geo-restricted content with ease.
- Privacy and Security: Maintain anonymity by routing traffic through proxy servers.

name: Vovsoft Proxy Switcher
description:
Vovsoft Proxy Switcher is a simple local proxy server that automatically forwards your traffic through multiple upstream proxies. Instead of configuring applications to switch proxies manually, you simply connect them to this program, and it handles the rotation for you in the background. This approach makes it easy to distribute requests, avoid rate limits — all without constantly reconfiguring your software.

Key Features:
* Acts as a local HTTP/HTTPS proxy server
* Automatically rotates requests through your proxy list
* Supports SSL/TLS connections
* Import, export, and manage proxy lists easily
* Lightweight and simple to use
* Ideal for developers, testers, marketers, and researchers who need a self-managed rotating proxy server for automation

This software does not provide proxy URLs. Users must supply their own proxies and ensure they are legally obtained and used in compliance with all applicable laws.

name: Vovsoft QR Code And Barcode Reader
description:
Vovsoft QR Code and Barcode Reader is a user-friendly software designed specifically for laptop and desktop computers. This application allows users to effortlessly scan and decode various types of barcodes and QR codes from file or webcam.

The software's intelligent scanning technology automatically detects code type. Whether you need to decode product information or access website links, this tool is the go-to software for Windows users seeking a reliable solution for scanning and reading two-dimensional (2D) QR codes or one-dimensional (1D) barcodes.

While there are various online QR code readers and online barcode readers, some users might prefer using a classic desktop app that does not require an Internet connection. The best part of this program is that the scanning is done completely offline. You are the only controller of your private data. No QR code or barcode information is sent to internet in any case.

Supported Formats:
- AZTEC
- CODABAR
- CODE 128, CODE 39, CODE 93
- DATA MATRIX (Center images only)
- EAN 13, EAN 8
- ITF
- MAXICODE
- MSI
- PDF 417
- PLESSEY
- QR CODE
- RSS 14, RSS EXPANDED
- UPC A, UPC E, UPC EAN EXTENSION

Key Features:
* Converts machine readable code to human readable text
* Supports various types of barcodes and QR codes
* An internet connection isn't needed
* Offline scanning ensures total privacy

name: Vovsoft RAM Benchmark
description:
Vovsoft RAM Benchmark is a benchmarking utility designed to assess the performance of your RAM, revealing the speed of the memory. You can quickly test the RAM speed of your desktop or laptop computer.

Whether you want to get information about the health of your RAM or check their specifications match, a benchmarking tool can do the trick. This software povides a means of assessing the performance of memories by running a benchmark test to find RAM speed. In an attempt to keep things as simple as possible, the program features a minimalistic interface that only allows you to start the test with the click of a button. If you will try to overclock your memory, you can easily use this program and get quick test results. On most motherboards, you can simply enable built-in "overclocking" profiles, which will show up as an "XMP" (Extreme Memory Profile) or "DOCP" (DRAM Overclocking Profile). After increasing or decreasing MHz value, you can measure the effect of this change on memory performance by using this test tool.

This application is a free memory benchmark tool and it supports DDR5, DDR4, DDR3, DDR2, DDR1 and SDRAM types. It usually doesn't take long before the result of the benchmark test is shown on the screen. The speed is revealed in MB/s.

Benchmark programs usually measure theoretical top speeds of devices. On the contrary Vovsoft RAM Benchmark measures the real-world speeds by allowing the user to change "Block Size" parameter. This program can write and read a huge memory block. If the memory has an issue, the performance will be degraded, as it is in real life.

Additionally, the software can check memory bandwidth. It tests system memory bandwidth using a process similar to the large memory-to-memory buffer copies in multimedia processing. This feature can only work when run as administrator.

name: Vovsoft RAM Monitor Gadget
description:
Vovsoft RAM Monitor Gadget is a RAM monitoring tool for anyone who wants to keep track of their computer's memory usage. This small but powerful RAM watcher provides real-time information about your system's RAM usage.

The software is designed to be easy to use, even for those with little technical knowledge. It displays the amount of RAM currently in use, as well as the total amount of RAM available, so you can see at a glance how much memory your system has to work with.

With this tool, you can quickly identify memory-hungry applications and processes and take action to optimize your system's performance. You can also use the gadget to monitor the effectiveness of any changes you make to your system, such as upgrading your RAM or closing unnecessary applications.

name: Vovsoft Random Wordlist Generator
description:
Vovsoft Random Wordlist Generator is a simple tool that allows you to create a word list of random characters. You can generate random words using different sets of characters. With a mouse click you can generate thousands of different words in seconds.

This utility allows you to choose predefined characters or define your own custom character set.
- Integers: 0-9
- Letters (lowercase): a-z
- Letters (uppercase): A-Z
- Others

name: Vovsoft Read Mode
description:
Vovsoft Read Mode is a reading mode application for your desktop or laptop PC. It removes everything that is unnecessary and present only the text. You can make blog posts, articles and webpages clean and easy to read.

Paste them into this software for better reading. You can configure the software with 3 predefined style options: Dark, Light and Sephia. You can print the refined text, read aloud or save as WAV for later listening. You can display any document in full-screen or windowed mode, Read Mode adjusts text according to your screen size. The software makes long chunks of text easier to read. All you need to do is copy and paste any text into the Read Mode software.

Key Features:
* Color options: Black, White, Dark, Sephia, Linen
* Full screen view
* Adjustable width
* Import from URL
* Read aloud (Automatic Text-to-Speech)
* Save as WAV file

name: Vovsoft RegEx Extractor
description:
Vovsoft RegEx Extractor is a simple but powerful data mining software utility designed to extract various data from text files or logs using regular expressions and rules (contains, lacks, starts with, ends with). One of its advantages is that it allows batch processing, enabling you to perform searches within multiple files at the same time.

Before clicking the "Start" button, you should drag'n'drop files or select the folder to scan. File masks are also supported. You can enter any regular expression (URLs, postal codes, phone numbers, dates, and many others). The results can be easily exported to a file and saved for future use.

When you select a matched text, it will show its source file. You have the option to export all matched texts in TXT format or texts along with their corresponding source files in CSV format.

name: Vovsoft Rename Multiple Files
description:
If you like to organize every bit of information on your computer, you must be interested in a software application that's capable of renaming multiple files at the same time. It significantly speeds up things, compared to manually changing the name of one file at once. Vovsoft Rename Multiple Files is a tiny tool that is designed with ease of use in mind. It can rename multiple files in bulk. It also has intuitive renaming settings that you can tailor to your preferences, such as automatic incrementation. This utility is an easy way to batch rename files.

To begin a task, you can add as many files as you want. The list shows the full path of each file, along with the new name, which makes sense only after the renaming job is complete. As far as file renaming rules are concerned, you can include the original file name, extension or both, add custom text, and insert numbers with auto incrementation. The format of the new file name can have any combination and order of these fields.

Renaming multiple files has never been easier! This file renamer program is an easy to use bulk rename utility. It has small memory footprint so it can be left running all the time without consuming all your memory. It can easily handle folders containing well over 100,000 entries. It is a mass file renamer software and it can batch rename 1,000s of files in seconds.

This software offers a powerful and efficient solution for bulk file renaming using CSV files. This user-friendly tool simplifies the tedious task of renaming multiple files in just a few clicks. By harnessing the power of CSV (Comma-Separated Values) files, users can create comprehensive lists of file name changes, making it ideal for projects requiring systematic renaming. Whether you're organizing your media library, managing documents, or need to standardize filenames for business purposes, this software streamlines the process. You can easily utilize popular spreadsheet software like Excel to edit the CSV spreadsheet, allowing for convenient customization of your renaming instructions. Simply import your CSV file with the desired name changes, and the software will swiftly apply these modifications to your files, saving you time and effort.

Use the "Load Files" and "Save Files" buttons to load and save CSV files. Wrap the values in quotation marks if they contain a CSV separator.

Example CSV structure:
C:\Directory\File1.txt,NewName1.txt
C:\Directory\File2.txt,NewName2.txt
C:\Directory\File3.txt,"New,Name3.txt"
"C:\Directory\File,4.txt","New,Name4.txt"

name: Vovsoft Resource Extractor
description:
Vovsoft Resource Extractor is a simple utility designed to help users scan files, and extract embedded resources from files like Windows executable (.exe) and dynamic-link library (.dll) files.

Whether you're a developer, a reverse engineer, or a power user, this tool simplifies the process of accessing graphics, icons, cursors, sounds, strings, and other data packaged within these files.
- Targeted Scanning: Easily specify a directory to scan, including the option to "Include Subfolders" for comprehensive searching.
- Flexible Filtering: Use wildcards like *.exe and *.dll to focus the search on specific file types. A "Case-Sensitive" option is also available for precision.
- Detailed File Listing: The results table provides essential metadata for the identified files, including the Filename (full path), Bits (x86 or x64 architecture), Extension, Date Modified, and Size (bytes).
- Visual Aid: The "Show Icons" option displays the embedded icon alongside the file path, offering a quick visual reference.
- File Size Calculation: The "Calculate Filesize" feature ensures you have accurate size information for the listed resources.
- Batch Extraction: Define a "Destination Folder" and use the "Extract All" button to quickly and efficiently save all found resources to a single location.
- User-Friendly Interface: The clear, intuitive design (as shown in the screenshot) ensures a simple and smooth extraction workflow.

name: Vovsoft Retail Barcode
description:
Vovsoft Retail Barcode is a lightweight cashier application that can help users keep track of products sales. If you are looking for a barcode software for your retail store, you can rely on this easy to use tool.

The tool allows one to define customers, as well as to link product credit sales to individual clients. The utility is valuable for anyone that is in the business of managing small shops. It is an ideal point of sale (POS) management software for small shops that are faced with a wide variety of products that have to be processed. Shops that do not stock items with barcodes can circumvent this issue by simply creating a customized store code (e.g. 1, 2, 3 and so on).

The software features a highly intuitive interface that is streamlined for an improved user-experience. Navigation is performed exclusively through large and self-explanatory buttons (e.g. Products or Customers). The program features a host of built-in interface layout options, which can suit most needs. In order to record sales, one must first define products. This is performed manually, by inserting the product's barcode, name and price or by importing from CSV files. Once this is performed, the program is ready to record regular sales.

All users have to do is to select the given item and specify the quantity of items sold. The utility then automatically computes total sales and stocks. Another method of operation is the "Sell by Credit" mode. This allows one to register product displacements that have not yet been paid for. Complementary to this method is the customer register. It allows store owners or cashiers to keep track of clients that purchase by credit. This module is a great method of keeping track of delayed transactions. Once a customer transfers the necessary sum, the balance is cleared. This means that all sales (by credit and by cash) can be processed with the same program. Sales totals for user-defined time intervals can also be generated.

Different passwords can be defined for administrator and cashier users. While the administrator can access all the menus and settings in the program, the cashier only has limited authority to make sales. For example, the administrator has the ability to delete the sale(s) due to returned goods or incorrect sales.

Key Features:
* Supports barcode and QR code scanners
* Import and export products using Excel
* "Sell by cash" and "Sell by credit"
* Add, edit, remove customers for credits
* Receipt printing
* Barcode label printing (Code 39)
* Ability to apply discount at checkout
* Embedded SQLite database

name: Vovsoft Rich Text Editor
description:
Vovsoft Rich Text Editor is a user-friendly document editing application. The software provides a clean interface with standard text formatting, allowing users to easily adjust fonts, alignment, and insert media.

Key Features:

* Fonts: Adjust font type, size, text and background color, as well as apply standard styles like bold, italics, underline, and strikethrough.
* Images: Supports images. Rather than just showing you the code for an image, the software will automatically download and display the actual pictures in your document, making it much easier to read and edit web-based content.
* Drag and Drop: You can easily drag and drop a file from Windows Explorer, or drag and drop text from other apps directly into the workspace.
* Printing: Includes full print and print preview capabilities.
* Spelling Check: Features built-in spell checking that supports all installed dictionaries in Windows (red underlines beneath unrecognized words).
* Emojis: Fully supports inserting and displaying color emojis to add visual expression and personality to your documents.
* Zoom: Easily scale your document view to your preference by adjusting the zoom percentage, allowing for comfortable reading and detailed editing.
* Command Line: Open a file using a command line parameter for quick access.

The application provides broad compatibility, supporting the following file formats:
* DOCX (Microsoft Word)
* RVF (RichView Format)
* RTF (RichText Format)
* HTML (HyperText Markup Language)
* Markdown
* Text
* PDF (export only)

name: Vovsoft Screen Reader
description:
Vovsoft Screen Reader is a lightweight accessibility tool that reduces the barriers low vision, visual impairments, and eye conditions can create when using your PC. Universal access matters, which is why it is crucial to make software as accessible as possible, helping more people take advantage of what modern computers have to offer.

This easy-to-use desktop utility is designed specifically for blind or visually impaired individuals. By combining automated reading and magnification into one simple tool, it aims to help those with poor vision navigate their computer more comfortably and with less eyestrain.

The software tries to dynamically detect the text under your mouse cursor or your active keyboard focus—such as when navigating through applications using the Tab key—and reads it aloud. This helps make interacting with standard Windows applications easier. You have full control to choose between your locally installed speech engines and adjust the reading speed.

Alongside audio feedback, the application features a built-in magnifier. The software smoothly enlarges the exact portion of the screen around your mouse cursor, helping make small text and interface elements easier to see. You can also customize the magnification factor to match your specific visual needs.

name: Vovsoft Search Text In Files
description:
Vovsoft Search Text In Files is an easy-to-use file search application for your desktop or laptop computer. You can search through your files using simple queries, and this tool will quickly list the requested files.

This program is simple text search software that allows you to quickly search your files. Select directory, enter "Filename Filter" and "Search Text", then click the "Start" button. Everything that meets the specified criteria will be listed. You can open, rename, copy or delete the resulting files by right-clicking. You can export the results into TXT or CSV file. You can display file size, and file icons using the settings. If you want to disregard files that contain a specified text, you can do this by utilizing the "Ignore Text" option.

This program has the capability to read from a wide variety of file formats.
- Plain-text Files: The program can read and process plain-text files. The most popular plain text file extension is TXT. However many extensions are actually plain text files such as CSV, JSON, LOG, HTML, XML.
- PDF Files: The program has the ability to handle PDF (Portable Document Format) files.
- DOC and DOCX Files: The program can read DOC (Microsoft Word Document) and DOCX (Microsoft Word Open XML Document) files.
- XLS and XLSX Files: The program can read XLS (Microsoft Excel Spreadsheet) and XLSX (Microsoft Excel Open XML Spreadsheet) files. These formats are used for storing spreadsheet data.
- PPT, PPTX, PPS, PPSX Files: The program can read PowerPoint files, presentations and slide shows.
- MSG Files: The program can read Outlook message item files.
- EML Files: The program has the capability to read EML (Internet Message Format) email files.

name: Vovsoft SEO Checker
description:
Vovsoft SEO Checker is an easy to use website crawler that can efficiently crawl both small and large websites. With this SEO checker tool, you can identify broken links, analyze on-page SEO data, distinguish between internal and external links, and classify links as dofollow or nofollow. Additionally, the tool provides analysis of internal linking, titles, description meta tags, and other tags in real-time.

On-page SEO (also known as "on-site SEO") is the practice of optimizing web page content for search engines and users. Common on-page SEO practices include optimizing title tags, content, internal links and URLs. This software provides full lists of sitemaps, links, internal backlinks, anchors, H1, H2, H3, H4 headings and helps you on your on-page SEO check efforts.

By using this SEO checker software, you can freely test your website or competitor websites in your niche, and rapidly get a technical SEO analysis report (including SEO errors) and valuable data. It can help you rank higher on Google, Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, DuckDuckGo.

Key Features:
* On-page SEO audit (checkup)
* Internal URL list
* Link and backlink lists
* Page title list
* META description list
* HTTP & HTTPS response codes
* Page speed
* Domain or subdomain based crawl
* H1, H2, H3, H4 heading lists
* Anchor list (prevent keyword cannibalization)
* Generate sitemap
* Export to CSV, XML, TXT
* Word count
* Embedded SQLite database (in-memory or file)

name: Vovsoft Serial Port Monitor
description:
Vovsoft Serial Port Monitor is an easy to use utility that allows monitoring your computer's COM port data traffic. You can read serial data from any COM port and send data to any COM port. You can change connection parameters such as baud rate (bits per second), parity, data bits and stop bits. This software can send and receive data in ASCII text. Hexadecimal, decimal, octal and binary formats are also supported when sending and displaying received data. It is possible to send serial commands periodically or according to a time schedule. "Clear", "Save to file" and "Copy to clipboard" buttons can be used. Setting font and background color is allowed by using the menu.

Using this simple COM port sniffer and logger program, you can test, monitor and control any hardware compliant with RS-232 protocol, RS-485 protocol, RS-422 protocol or other compatible serial port device. The RS-232 (DB9) pinout specifies that only the RX (receiver) and TX (transmitter) pins are necessary for communication. The rest of the pins are necessary only if you implement some form of hardware flow control. You can easily read incoming data from RX and send outgoing data to TX with the help of a serial port analyzer and tester software, such as Vovsoft Serial Port Monitor. This application is an easy to use serial input listener and output transmitter software for students and electronic enthusiasts. Your desktop or laptop computer can communicate between microcontrollers (such as Arduino boards) or microprocessors (such as Raspberry Pi single-board computers) via serial communication with the help of this software.

This program allows you to send serial commands periodically or according to a time schedule.
- Send Periodically: Sends the same command repeatedly at a specified interval in milliseconds
- Send Later: Sends commands at a later time by entering a future date and time

name: Vovsoft Silence Remover
description:
Vovsoft Silence Remover is a Windows software designed to simplify audio editing by automatically removing unwanted pauses and silent segments from your recordings. Whether you’re a podcaster striving for smooth narration or a vlogger aiming for seamless video voiceovers, Silence Remover helps you achieve professional-quality results effortlessly.

Long silences and pauses in audio can disrupt the flow of your content, making it less engaging for listeners. Silence Remover automates the tedious process of identifying and removing these pauses, allowing you to focus on creating content that captivates your audience.
- Batch Processing: Save time by processing multiple audio files in one go. Ideal for projects involving large volumes of recordings.
- Wide Format Support: Compatible with popular audio file formats, including MP3 and WAV.
- Offline Functionality: No internet connection required—Silence Remover works entirely offline, ensuring privacy and consistent performance.
- Unlimited File Length: Process audio files of any duration without limitations, making it perfect for lengthy podcasts, interviews, or audiobooks.
- Customizable Silence Detection: Adjust the threshold decibel (dB) value to fine-tune silence detection and set the minimum pause duration for removal. This level of customization ensures precise results tailored to your needs.
- Fast and Efficient Workflow: Quickly process audio files while maintaining high-quality output, enhancing your productivity.

Who Can Benefit from Silence Remover?
- Podcasters: Create polished, engaging episodes by removing distracting pauses.
- Vloggers: Maintain audience attention by cutting out unnecessary silences in voiceovers.
- Audiobook Creators: Deliver seamless narration with no awkward gaps.
- Anyone Working with Audio: From music producers to content creators, anyone who wants cleaner, more professional audio can benefit from Silence Remover.

name: Vovsoft Sitemap Generator
description:
Vovsoft Sitemap Generator is a lightweight website crawler designed to help you freely create a sitemap in a couple of simple steps. It can come in handy in a number of scenarios, and it features a minimalistic, user-friendly GUI. This application is well suited for those who need to create a sitemap quickly and easily, as it does not require you to complete any complex configurations before performing a scan.

The application is capable of ignoring certain extensions that are not important and will just increase the scanning time unnecessarily. Moreover, specific URLs can be disregarded. Once a scan has been completed, the program allows you to export the results to XML, CSV, TXT or HTML files. The XML file can be submitted to major search engines (Google, Bing, Yandex, etc.), while the HTML sitemap can allow website visitors to easily navigate on your site.

With this XML sitemap generator, you can create sitemaps for Google and other search engines. Submit your XML sitemap to "Google Search Console". As a website owner, you should keep your sitemap up to date. Google bots read your sitemap regularly, so be sure to include all the content that you want Google to crawl. Avoid including URLs in your sitemaps that shouldn't appear in search. This can waste your crawl budget on pages that shouldn't be indexed.

name: Vovsoft Software Manager
description:
Vovsoft Software Manager is a utility designed to help users conveniently keep track of and manage their installed Vovsoft applications from a single, centralized interface.

- Comprehensive Overview: It displays a detailed list of all installed Vovsoft programs, showing the application name, the currently installed version, the latest available version, and the local installation path.
- Update Tracking: The manager helps identify which applications are out of date by comparing the installed version with the latest release, highlighting newer available versions in bold text.
- Installation & Uninstallation Controls: A right-click context menu allows users to manage the software directly. You can install updates or uninstall programs using standard, "Silent," or "Very Silent" execution modes.
- Quick Access: The context menu provides fast access to open the specific application's folder on your computer ("Show in Explorer") or navigate directly to the product's official website.
- Sync and Refresh: It includes options to refresh the local list of installations (F5) and manually pull the latest version data from the server to ensure your update status is accurate.

name: Vovsoft Sound Recorder
description:
Vovsoft Sound Recorder helps you record your system sound and microphone with ease. It saves audio from your input device (microphone) or from your output device (loopback recording).

This program supports recording the following:
- System sound (Speaker or microphone not required)
- Microphone
- Both (Combined)

name: Vovsoft Vocal and Instrumental Splitter
description:
Vovsoft Vocal and Instrumental Splitter is a dedicated desktop utility designed to effortlessly extract human vocals and background music from your audio tracks. Whether you are creating karaoke backing tracks, gathering samples for a remix, or analyzing instrumentation, this tool isolates the core audio components and saves them as distinct, ready-to-use files.

Compatible with a wide range of standard and high-fidelity audio files, including WAV, MP3, M4A, WMA, OGG, and FLAC.

Key Features:
* Dual File Output: Automatically creates two separate audio files for every track processed—one containing the isolated human vocals and the other containing the instrumental backing track.
* Batch Processing: The interface allows you to add individual files or entire folders, making it easy to queue and process multiple tracks in a single session.
* Customizable Output: Select your desired output audio type from a convenient dropdown menu and specify whether to save the split tracks in the original source folder or a custom directory.
* Complete Offline Privacy: Powered by the ONNX runtime, all audio source separation happens entirely on your local machine. No cloud servers, internet connection, or data uploads are required, guaranteeing your files remain private.
* Zero Dependencies: The software runs natively as a standalone application. There is no need to install complex Python environments or third-party frameworks.

Because neural network-based audio separation is highly resource-intensive, this software utilizes multi-threaded CPU operations and system RAM. While it is optimized for modern hardware, users running older computers may experience longer processing times during extraction.

description:
Vovsoft Voice Changer is a free audio enhancer and voice modifier tool that lets you add special sound effects to your recordings. Finally, you will need to save your file so you don't lose it. The export options are .WAV and .MP3. - Automatically Add Excel Files: The application automatically scans the executable directory and adds all found Excel files to the list.

Unlike online converters that require uploading sensitive or confidential XML data to remote servers, this tool works offline on your computer. Your private information—financial records, customer databases, product inventories, medical data, and more—never leaves your device.

* XML to CSV

name: VX Search
description:
VX Search is an automated, rule-based file search solution allowing one to search files by the file type, category, extension, file name, file size, location, creation, modification and last access dates, regular expressions, user name, file attributes, binary and text patterns, JPEG EXIF tags, etc.

The user is provided with the ability to categorize and filter file search results, perform file management operations, generate various types of pie and bars charts, save reports to a number of standard formats such as HTML, PDF, Excel, text, CSV, XML and export search results to an SQL database.

IT administrators are provided with advanced file search capabilities including the ability to search files in multiple servers and/or NAS storage devices simultaneously, periodic file search operations, automatic report generation, conditional file search actions allowing one to send E-Mail notifications and/or execute custom commands when a file search operation finds a user-specified number of files.

In addition to the VX Search GUI application, the user is provided with a command line utility, which can be used to execute pre-configured file search operations and integrated into user-custom shell scripts and batch files. The VX Search command line utility may be used to execute file search operations locally or control file search operations in one or more VX Search Servers via the network.

name: VX Search Server
description:
VX Search Server is a rule-based file search server, which runs in the background as a service and provides the ability to search files in one or more directories, disks, network shares or NAS storage devices by the file name, directory, regular expressions, file size, file type, file attributes, user name, creation, last modification or last access dates, text and binary patterns, JPEG EXIF tags, etc.

VX Search Server allows one to setup an unlimited number of files search operations, with each one capable of searching files using an extensive set of file matching rules combined with logical operators. Power users are provided with the ability to combine multiple types of rules into hierarchical file search queries capable of precisely searching required types or groups of files. For example, VX Search Server allows one to search for all types of documents with the file size more than X MB that were modified during the last Y months.

VX Search Server may be controlled using a full-scale client GUI application and a command line utility locally or via the network. The user is provided with the ability to review file search results, generate HTML, PDF, text, CSV, XML reports or export file search results from multiple servers to a centralized SQL database for future review and analysis. In addition, VX Search Server provides the ability to schedule periodic file search operations according to user-defined time intervals, automatically generate reports and/or send E-Mail notifications when a file search operation finds a user-specified number of file search results.
